capture_forget.description: When present, forgetting withdraws every retained part, projection and revision of this captured fragment, which can include adjacent messages. archive_weight.description: Multiplier for matches in archive directories; 1 leaves priority unchanged. Recent ordering applies it within comparable matches. half_life_days.description: Age in days at which half of the maximum recency reduction applies.

recency_weight.description: Maximum fractional reduction in ordering score due to source age; 0 disables it.

recent_relevance_ratio.description: For recent ordering, prioritize candidates within this fraction of the best passage query coverage when at least two terms match, or rank fusion with available question-coverage support otherwise. delete.description:
Withdraw a memory with reviewer authority or eligible authorship.

Contributors may withdraw their own ordinary, unverified memory only
when every revision belongs to them. Otherwise returns requires_reviewer.
Authorization and expected_version are checked at the write boundary;
can_forget on memory details is an observation, not a reusable grant.
Read capture_forget on current memory details and explain its scope to
the user before confirmation. A captured fragment deletion includes its
raw evidence, conversation projections and older revisions, and may
include adjacent messages. Later deliveries of that fragment remain
forgotten; this is not semantic deletion across producer generations.
delete.summary: Forget a memory; inspect capture_forget before deleting an entire captured fragment
